messages:
maria: paging in — incident-bot alerted P1 for embeddings latency in eu-west-1. I saw a spike starting ~22:12 UTC and it's still elevated. I'm taking primary until 07:00 UTC to run triage and mitigation. details from alert: embeddings-queue tail p99 > 1.2s, error rate up ~0.8%.
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 embeddings-queue eu-west-1 — p95/p99 latency breach; triggered at 2026-03-15T22:12:03Z. Pager: eng-oncall.
jamal: @maria thanks — are we seeing any deploys around that time? any config changes to KV cache or routing?
maria: there was a small config push at 22:05 that changed kv_cache.max_entries from 5000 -> 20000 to improve hit rate. rolling -> 3 nodes. logs show frequent KV eviction warnings after ~22:10. hypothesis: cache growth + eviction/underprovisioned memory causing thrash and longer KV lookups.
lee: do we have a quick mitigation to reduce impact to customers? can we pin to older config or promote standby pool?
maria: working on it. steps I'm running now:
```
# verify relay pods and restart if unhealthy
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=relay -o wide
# check kv eviction metrics
curl -sS http://relay-metrics:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_evictions
# promote standby pool if needed
redwood route promote --pool eu-west-1-standby --service embeddings --dry-run
```
devon: if promoting, watch for cold-start penalty on first few requests. recommend doing gradual weight shift via route weights (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
anika: tagging runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-kv-cache — follow 'cache regression' section. also note: runbook says to open ticket IR- and schedule retro if config change caused P1.
opsbot: action logged: created incident record IR-4321 (embeddings-kv-cache-thrash). Pager escalations: maria -> jamal (secondary) -> lee (escalation) at +15m.
jamal: i'm on my way online, will be secondary in ~5m. Maria — please paste the top relay logs and the command to rollback config so I can assist.
maria: pasted logs: 
```
[22:11:58] relay[main] WARN kv_cache: evicting entry id=0x7f3a, size=24MB, reason=memory_pressure
[22:12:02] relay[main] ERROR store: kv lookup timeout 1203ms key=user:vec:abc123
[22:12:05] relay[main] WARN batcher: queue latency increased p99=1.45s
```
rollback command i'm preparing: `kubectl -n infra set configmap relay-cache-config --from-literal=max_entries=5000` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/relay`. doing a canary restart on 1 pod first.
lee: please add runbook pointer to the handoff note so next shift knows escalation path — there was a small gap: secondary wasn't formally assigned in handoff this morning. we should add explicit primary/secondary sticky flag in the shift doc.
maria: agreed — adding to followups. current state: canary restarted, the restarted pod shows lower kv evictions and p95 dropped from 420ms -> 110ms. promoting standby pool by weight 20% now. monitoring.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] promotion started. route weights: primary 80% -> standby 20%. metrics will take ~30s to reflect.
devon: observing customer impact: degraded latencies for embeddings API but error rate stable; product asked for ETA for full mitigation. recommend estimate 45m to full roll.
anika: filing two follow-ups: ticket IR-4322 (runbook update: explicit handoff primary/secondary marker) and IR-4323 (postmortem and capacity plan for kv cache sizing). scheduling retro for 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC. invite: eng-oncall, eng-runtime, product-ops.
jamal: confirmed — I took secondary. monitoring dashboards look stable post-canary. happy to hand back to on-call rotation when you need, @maria.
maria: thanks all. summary/action items in thread: 1) IR-4321 incident record created (live). 2) IR-4322 add handoff sticky primary/secondary in shift doc. 3) IR-4323 PM+SRE retro and capacity plan. 4) short-term: rollback cache config and gradual route promotion executed. 5) long-term: add autosizing alert and pre-merge guard for cache-config changes. I'll update the incident record and close handoff once metrics stable for 30m.
opsbot: note: follow-up tasks assigned to maria, jamal, anika. retro scheduled and calendar invites sent.
maria: closing handoff note — I'm handing primary back to rotation at 07:00 UTC tomorrow. if anything spikes again I'll re-open the thread. :white_check_mark:
